playerCharacter.name: The Survivor

stats.agility: battle-tested (dodged lethal swing, rolled across shifting tile)

goals: Confront the Mirror Self (battle in progress)

npcs.name: Forgotten Soul
npcs.description: Whispers from the void, now revealed as dual-natured—some scream WARNING, others whisper EMBRACE IT. Their divided voices echo through the warping corridor during the mirror battle.

npcs.name: The Mirror Self
npcs.description: A sentient doppelganger wielding a blade, wearing The Survivor's face. Taunts with 'You think you earned this?' and claims to know everything The Survivor has forgotten. Catches lost memories midair. Dwell within the Hidden Bunker.

Tower of Hell grid.description: A server with a hidden secret, shrouded in thunderous dread and a bruised sky. The corridor now warps—walls breathe, floors tilt.
notableFeatures: Shifting laser beams carving the air like razors
Warping corridor with breathing walls and tilting floors

Hidden Bunker.description: A guarded area with a mystery to crack, now breached and warping. Inside: a mirror holding a sinister reflection. The battle for identity rages within—steel meets will across shifting tile.

Awakened Fruit.description: A powerful fruit with unknown abilities, now actively surging within The Survivor like a waking beast during moments of extreme pressure. Erupted with heat during the mirror confrontation, pulsing like a second heartbeat.

Blade (Mirror Self).description: A blade wielded by the Mirror Self, its edge catching pale light. Used to slash at The Survivor and extract memories.

Lost Memory.description: A memory that fell from The Survivor during the blade clash—caught midair by the Mirror Self, who claims to know everything The Survivor has forgotten.
